acceptance_predicates.description: A separate process can die at the admitted factory durable effect boundary for Git and SQLite without publishing false success.
Fresh durable state classifies the journal as ambiguous or safe-mode and records a bounded recovery decision before any retry.
Recovery preserves backend, operation, barrier, fencing, session revision, and exact authority identity checks.
Independent exact-head review, hosted checks, post-merge checks, and state reconciliation pass.

definition_of_done: Git and SQLite admitted factory process-death campaigns are implemented and independently tested.
No death boundary is treated as successful or retryable without durable recovery evidence.
AR-0114, AR-0009, and AR-0031 can consume the evidence truthfully.

inputs.description: Completed admitted Git staging and eight-phase factory sequencing.
Existing production phase wiring and durable effect boundaries.

outputs.description: Reproducible fresh-process Git/SQLite process-death and recovery evidence.

gates.description: Intent is durable before the death injection and recovery is fail-closed.
A distinct reviewer checks the exact candidate head and hosted evidence.
